text: First screen: a small floating grassy island in the ocean, a bunny-like creature with a blue hood seen from behind, trees. HUD says Day 2, 11/30 sec, 10 coins, Lv1 0/100. A hint says 'Tap an empty tile' with a yellow box highlighting a patch of grass. Going to tap inside that box.
A build menu popped up: Farm 10 dollars (I have 10), Mine opens Lv3, Lumberyard Lv2, Research lab Lv2, Special 0/1. Sky turning dusk already - days are only 30 seconds. Building the farm.
Coins went to 0. Farm is under construction, 4 sec. It became night with a moon - very pretty day/night cycle. Waiting for it to finish.
Farm built, got 5 XP, now Day 3. The bunny has a heart bubble - cute. Hint: Tap the farm to sow. Bottom shows Sow / Water / Harvest steps, 5 sec each. Tapping the farm.

Oops, the bunny walked onto the farm and I tapped HER instead. Her name is Momo, 'Free time', with an Assign button. There's a pencil icon above her (rename?). The hint still says tap the farm to sow. Let me try Assign, maybe that puts her to work on the farm.
Assign button lit up greenish but nothing obvious changed; Momo still says Free time. Maybe now I pick a building? Tapping the farm at its left edge, away from Momo.

OK! Momo is now 'Working at Farm', farm skill 0, 0 jobs, 'Stays here', 'Route: Nearest first'. So Assign then tap a building = put her to work. Not super obvious but the hint helped. Hint says the bar fills then it's done. Waiting.
Day 4. +1 EXP, Momo has done 1 job. But I don't see crops yet and no coins. I don't actually see a bar filling - just a '1' badge. Closing her panel by tapping the sea to see the farm's own state.
Now I see it: a green ring above the farm is filling - that's 'the bar'. Gorgeous sunset. Waiting for the ring to finish.
XP 7 now. Tiny sprouts in the farm? Momo has a '...' speech bubble and the hint now says 'Tap a Momo'. Tapping her.
Tapped Momo: 2 jobs done. New hint: 'Its tiles light up. The pencil edits them.' So the pencil edits which tiles she works? Tapping the pencil.
Edit mode: '1/4 tiles', tap tiles or drag across them. So Momo can cover up to 4 tiles. But I only have one farm... Trying to tap a grass tile next to the farm to see what happens.

Now 2/4 tiles - the empty grass tile I tapped turned blue (added to Momo's area). The farm has leafy plants now! A text box explains: plants need time between waterings, any empty tile can build farm/mine/lumberyard/lab, demolish = tap, bin, check, half refunded. A lot of text at once. Tapping Got it.
Island looks like a 2x2 grid of tiles; farm on top. The left tile is now in Momo's zone. Still 0 coins - I want the harvest to pay out. Confirming with the check mark.
Tile edit saved, the tutorial bubbles are gone. Now I just want to see the crops get harvested and coins come in. Waiting ~10 seconds.
Red fruits are hanging in the farm now - ripe! 4 jobs done (sow, water, ...). Next should be harvest. Waiting a bit more for coins.
Momo seems to be harvesting now (ring filling, red fruit near her ears). Patience... still 0 coins.

Harvest done: XP jumped 9 -> 29, but coins are still 0. Odd. There was a cut-off '1 c...' text at the right screen edge (clipped). Mailbox got a red dot and Momo shows an envelope bubble. Opening the Mailbox.
Coins finally 5! (so maybe a separate selling step after harvest). Mailbox has a letter from Momo: 'What if we widened the field?' Aww. Opening it.

Charming letter from Momo: set rows closer, till to the edges, more plants on the same island. 'Proposal - Field expansion' with a 'Let's research it' button. I love that the upgrade comes as a letter from the character. Tapping Let's research it.
Button changed to 'On the research list'. Let's look at the Research screen.

Research tree! Tabs: Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games, Ca(t?)... Field expansion costs 0/3 flasks + 20 dollars, 1 min, needs a research lab (which opens at Lv2). Big tree below it (watering, bigger harvests, greenhouse, drip irrigation, millet). What is a flask though? I don't have any. Closing and checking Status.

Status: island is called Momonium, 'A small island, a big tomorrow.' Farm Lv1 39/100 EXP. Village -> City goal: Land 4/9, Momo 1/3, Research levels 0/3, value produced 5 / 1.5K. So there's a long-term goal: more land, more Momos. Got it, then peeking at Store tab.
Store tab: Crops 0/20, Made 1. So the one crop got sold automatically for 5 dollars I guess. Checking Money tab.

Money tab: 5 earned, 10 spent, and 'Island worth 49 - Sell...' - selling the whole island? Sounds like a prestige/restart thing, not touching it yet. One harvest cycle took about a minute and a half for only 5 dollars, feels slow. Closing and checking the Shop.

Shop has just one thing: Hire Momo, 25 dollars. Second crop already ripening - faster this time. Plan: save 10 dollars and build a second farm on the left tile, which I already put in Momo's work area. Then save for a second Momo. Closing shop and letting time pass.

Second harvest: XP 33 -> 53, and again a clipped '1 c' popup on the very right edge of the screen, I can't read it. Coins still 5 - money seems to arrive later than the harvest. Waiting to see when it lands.
That '1 c' text is stuck on the right edge under the level bar, cut off. Coins still 5. Checking Status > Store to see if the crop is sitting in storage instead of being sold.
Got it: crops are sold when a new day starts - now 10 coins on Day 12. Made 2 crops total. Time to build the second farm on the left tile.
Build menu is up, though I can't clearly see which tile is selected (the menu covers it). Building Farm for 10.
Second farm is being built on the left tile - right where I wanted. Scaffolding poles, nice touch. Waiting for it, then I'll see if Momo picks it up on her own since it's in her zone.

Yes! Momo walked over to the new farm on her own and is sowing it, while the first farm grows leafy plants. Two farms going. Lv 61/100 - Lv2 will unlock lumberyard and research lab. There's a 'Farm 1/1 >' label at the bottom - tapping it to see what the arrow does.

Farm detail panel: a cycle gives 1 crop; 'Cycle by hand 1 min 10s' vs 'Cycle by Momo 1 min 48s' - so I can work farms myself and I'm faster than Momo! Crop choices (hardy crop, millet locked), and refits into Villa/Park/Pub at higher levels. Closing it and trying to work the FIRST farm by hand with the Sow/Water/Harvest buttons.

Tapped Momo again by accident - she keeps standing on the building I aim for. Farm skill went up to 1, 15 jobs. The farms are numbered 1 and 2 (her route order I think). Got it, then tapping the right corner of farm 1 to avoid her.
Farm 1 selected: full of ripe tomatoes, Harvest button says '5s left'. The pencil tip popped up again even though I pressed Got it. Waiting 5s then tapping Harvest myself.

When I tapped Harvest, Momo had already walked back and started harvesting farm 1 herself (Farm 1/1). The button shows a progress bar but I can't tell whether it's me helping or just her. Farm 2 has leafy plants. Waiting for the harvest.
Harvest done, XP 86/100 - close to Lv2. Momo already re-sowed and is watering. Another letter from Momo (envelope bubble + red dot). Reading it.
New letter: 'Maybe we could water less often'. She's clearly feeling the watering pain (water x3 per crop). Opening and adding it to research.

Letter about straw mulch / slow seep watering -> Proposal: Watering efficiency. 5 coins arrived at dawn (Day 16). Adding to research, then I'll try watering farm 1 myself - its Water button says 5s left.
Farm 2 is full of ripe tomatoes while Momo is busy watering farm 1. Perfect chance to harvest farm 2 by hand. Selecting farm 2 then Harvest.

Argh. Momo walked onto farm 2 just as I tapped it, so I selected HER, and my second tap landed on her 'Release' button instead of Harvest. Now she's on 'Free time'. Frustrating that she keeps standing on the thing I want to tap. Re-assigning her: Assign, then tap the farm.
LEVEL 2! (9/180). Momo is back to work but only farm 1 has a badge now - re-assigning reset her zone. Using the pencil to add farm 2 back.
Farm 2 is back in her zone (2/4 tiles, badges 1 and 2). Confirming. Then let me check what a Research lab costs on an empty tile now that I'm Lv2.
Lv2 prices: Lumberyard 80, Research lab 45, Farm 10. I have 10 (sold at dawn). The lab is a long way off at 5 coins per crop. Peeking at 'Special 0/1' first.
Special = landmarks: Clock Tower (Lv5), School (Lv4), Momo Monument (Lv6) - one of each. A Momo Monument, ha. Long-term carrots. Going back and building a third farm with my 10 coins.
Third farm going up on the right tile. Harvest sold at dawn so I have 5 left, Lv2 32/180. Once it's built I'll add it to Momo's tiles with the pencil (3/4).
Farm 3 is built and selected, nobody working it (0/1), Sow button is lit. Sowing it myself this time.
Seeds flying into farm 3 - I'm sowing it by hand, the bar under Sow is filling. Feels good to contribute. Next I'll water.
Seeds planted in neat dots in farm 3. Water is lit now. Watering by hand.

Water droplets falling on farm 3 under my hand while Momo tends farms 1 and 2. Three farms, island is almost full (one grass tile left). With about a minute left: I like the cozy look and the letters, but money is slow - 5 dollars per crop, lab costs 45. Letting it run.
Farm 3 sprouted! The Water button has three little dots on top - first one filled, so that's the 'water x3' count. Watering again.

Second watering going on farm 3. Farm 2 is red with ripe tomatoes again, Momo is on farm 1. Nothing sold this dawn, still 5 coins. Final thought: calm and pretty, I understood the loop, but I'd want income to speed up soon to keep me.
